title: Gave it 3 months, personally didn’t like the quality or selections
text: I went 3 months, and it was ok, but not great. This time I got some chocolate covered pretzels, gummy gingerbread men which were of poor quality, something covered in chocolate I could not identify, and some stale mints.  It’s a great idea, but the candy is either just ok or sub-oar
label: negative
